autoMode.warning: In auto mode the assistant makes changes straight away — including deleting things — without asking you first. It still asks when an action is expected to cost more than the cost limit shown under the switch (or when its cost can't be estimated); the limit applies to each action, not to their total. You'll still see what it did in the chat. You can switch back at any time.

generic.heading: How can I help?
generic.copy: Ask about ReelBolt, your projects or workflows. It asks before it changes anything, unless you turn on auto mode.
generic.s1Prompt: Who am I, what can I do on this platform, and what page am I on?
generic.s2Prompt: What can you help me with on this page?
generic.s3Prompt: List my projects and what each one contains.
generic.s4Prompt: Which agents can I use for video editing, and what does each one do?

dashboard.heading: Welcome back. Want a quick status?
dashboard.copy: I can summarise what is running, what failed and where to pick up.
dashboard.s1Prompt: Summarise my recent workflow activity and anything that failed.
dashboard.s2Prompt: Based on my projects, what should I work on next?
dashboard.s3Prompt: Help me set up a promo video workflow for one of my projects.
dashboard.s4Prompt: Explain what the stats on my dashboard (runs, credits, projects) mean.

projects.heading: Looking for a project?
projects.copy: I can find, compare or help you set up projects.
projects.s1Prompt: List my projects with their status and file counts.
projects.s2Prompt: Help me create a new project for a promo video.
projects.s3Prompt: Which of my projects had the most recent workflow activity?

project.heading: Working on this project
project.copy: Ask about its files, workflows or outputs, or have me draft a workflow.
project.s1Prompt: Summarise this project: its files, workflows and latest outputs.
project.s2Prompt: Which files in this project are most relevant for a promo video?
project.s3Prompt: Draft a workflow for this project that produces a promotional video.
project.s4Prompt: What are this project's latest outputs and did any run fail?

projectFiles.heading: Project files
projectFiles.copy: I can search and summarise what you uploaded.
projectFiles.s1Prompt: Summarise the files in this project.
projectFiles.s2Prompt: Search this project's files for the product's key features.
projectFiles.s3Prompt: What files would help produce a better video that this project lacks?

projectWorkflows.heading: This project's workflows
projectWorkflows.copy: I can explain, compare or draft workflows.
projectWorkflows.s1Prompt: List this project's workflows and what each one does.
projectWorkflows.s2Prompt: Draft a new workflow for this project.
projectWorkflows.s3Prompt: Which workflow template fits this project best, and why?

workflowNew.heading: Building a workflow
workflowNew.copy: Describe the video you want and I will propose the steps.
workflowNew.s1Prompt: Propose a workflow that turns this project into a promo video.
workflowNew.s2Prompt: Propose a workflow that derushes and cuts a source video.
workflowNew.s3Prompt: What step types can a workflow use, and when do I pick each?

workflow.heading: How can I help with this workflow?
workflow.copy: Ask me to explain steps, suggest improvements or draft an edit. Nothing is saved until you apply it.
workflow.s1Prompt: Explain what this workflow does, step by step.
workflow.s2Prompt: Add a Review step at the end with a minimum score of 8.
workflow.s3Prompt: Suggest how to make this workflow run faster without losing quality.
workflow.s4Prompt: Which agents can I use for video editing, and what does each one do?

execution.heading: Looking at a run
execution.copy: I can explain what happened, why a step failed and what to change.
execution.s1Prompt: Explain what happened in this execution, step by step.
execution.s2Prompt: If this execution failed, why, and how do I fix it?
execution.s3Prompt: How could I improve the result of this run?
execution.s4Prompt: Where did this execution spend most of its time and tokens?

editor.heading: In the video editor
editor.copy: This is the timeline: clips, sound and titles. I can explain it or change the workflow that produced it. The cutting itself is yours.
editor.s1Prompt: Explain how this edit was assembled.
editor.s2Prompt: How do I trim and arrange clips in this timeline editor?
editor.s3Prompt: Which workflow setting would change this cut, and how?

editorHub.heading: On the Editor page
editorHub.copy: This lists your timelines, media and pictures. Videos open on a timeline, pictures in the picture editor.
editorHub.s1Prompt: What is on this page and which editor does each thing open in?
editorHub.s2Prompt: Which of my renders should I turn into a thumbnail, and how?
editorHub.s3Prompt: What have I rendered recently and did any run fail?

pictures.heading: Your pictures
pictures.copy: These are the pictures you can edit. Opening one puts you in the picture editor, where I can change its layers or design a graphic.
pictures.s1Prompt: Which of my pictures is best for a thumbnail, and why?
pictures.s2Prompt: How do I change the words on one of these pictures?
pictures.s3Prompt: What is the difference between editing a picture and editing the video?

pictureEditor.heading: In the picture editor
pictureEditor.copy: I can look at this picture, change its layers or design a graphic for it. You see every change on the canvas.
pictureEditor.s1Prompt: Describe this picture and its layers.
pictureEditor.s2Prompt: Make the title on this picture stand out more.
pictureEditor.s3Prompt: Design a sale badge for this picture and place it in the top right.
pictureEditor.s4Prompt: How can I clean up the background of this picture?

agents.heading: Choosing an agent
agents.copy: I can explain what each agent does and which one fits.
agents.s1Prompt: Which agents can I use for video editing, and what does each one do?
agents.s2Prompt: Which agent should I use to plan motion graphics?
agents.s3Prompt: Help me write a custom agent definition.

agent.heading: About this agent
agent.copy: Ask what it does, what tools it has and how to use it in a workflow.
agent.s1Prompt: What does this agent do and what are its tools?
agent.s2Prompt: How do I use this agent in a workflow step?
agent.s3Prompt: Suggest improvements to this agent's system prompt.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.copy: Ask about your account and preferences.
settings.s1Prompt: How do I change my password?
settings.s2Prompt: What am I allowed to do on this platform?
